name: Matrix Chat
description: Connects DMS to a Matrix homeserver such as Synapse. Rooms, direct messages, attachments, replies, reactions, edits, typing and read receipts appear in the DMS chat window, with end-to-end encryption, older history fetched as you scroll, and your Matrix notification settings followed.
author: neo
warning: Signing in creates a new device, which cannot read messages sent before it existed. To read encrypted history, verify this device with your recovery key below.
